headline: Jefferies Sees Valuation Upside in Select Indian IT Stocks
summary: Jefferies identified potential valuation upside in selected Indian IT stocks such as Infosys and TCS despite muted overall sector growth forecasts.
why: Indian IT services firms rely on global technology spending; analyst reratings influence institutional portfolio allocations in the sector.

impacts.name: Indian IT Services
impacts.why: Positive analyst coverage and target price upgrades can attract institutional capital into select technology equities.
